description:
Haesol is a young unemployed man who cheerfully overcomes countless hardships with the power of alcohol, and in front of him appears Hayun, who shows up after 13 years with suspicious hidden intentions; it is an otherworldly romance between Haesol and Hayun in which one of them must die for the other to live.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list.nhn?titleId=835004), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11990945)
